name: Herdr attention
author: Alex van den Berg
description: Which Herdr agents need you: questions, approvals, failures, finished work and possible stalls, from the local herdr-attention collector. Read-only. Also reports keyboard/mouse idle (never keystrokes) for phone alert gating.

barWidget.description: Agents that need you first, then working, then the rest. Settings for watched workspaces, event types, stall time and phone alerts.
